Example limma-voom results from airway dataset

Source: R/data.R
airway_voom.Rd

A dataset containing differential expression results from comparing treated vs untreated samples in the airway dataset using limma-voom.

Usage

airway_voom

Format

A data frame with columns:

logFC

Log2 fold change between treated and untreated conditions

AveExpr

Average log2 expression

t

Moderated t statistic

P.Value

Moderated t-test p-value

adj.P.Val

Benjamini-Hochberg adjusted p-value

B

Log-odds of differential expression

ensembl

Ensembl gene ID

symbol

Gene symbol

Source

Generated from the airway Bioconductor package using limma. The contrast compares dexamethasone treatment ("trt") vs untreated ("untrt").

Author

Jared Andrews

Examples

library(VizModules)
head(airway_voom)
#>                    logFC  AveExpr        t      P.Value    adj.P.Val        B
